prompts.name: 01_NianGuardian
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished Android launcher icon for the Chinese New Year pixel-art roguelike card-battler 爆竹驱年 (SlayTheNian). Create ONE square 1024x1024 image, full bleed opaque background, NOT a sheet, collage, mockup or grid. Authentic chunky 16-bit pixel art: coherent visible square pixel clusters, hard stepped contours, limited color palette, very restrained dithering, no antialiasing or smooth vector rendering. Colors echo this game's deep plum burgundy #291C2A, crimson red, warm ivory and festive gold. Clear bold silhouette, one large central focal subject, important content inside central 70% so launcher masks have room, readable at 48px. Pixelated highlights only, no smooth gradients, no glossy 3D, no photorealism, no busy fine detail. Fill the square background to all edges. No rounded square frame, no baked rounded corners, no letters, no numerals, no Chinese characters, no logos, no watermark. Subject: a close-up portrait of a lovable but powerful Chinese Nian beast, one big expressive ivory muzzle, red and maroon fur, two curved golden horns, emerald green brows, gold bell under the chin. It resembles a traditional Chinese lion dance creature, playful fierce confident eyes, facing three quarters toward viewer. Face and horns fill most of composition. Burgundy background with only a few large square golden sparks. Heroic festive adventure mood. Strong dark outline and simple large planes of pixel shading.
